dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped geometries exhibit high-contrast perimeters with sharp dark-to-light gradients. Edge boundaries are non-uniform and interlocking, particularly in the mid-dorsal region where light-gray interiors are bounded by high-density dark pixel perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid high-intensity clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the lower lateral transition zone and the anterior-most region of the torso near the neck fold.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A distinct triangular cluster is formed by three large, isolated annuli centroids on the upper mid-section. A linear chain of smaller centroids extends from the dorsal ridge toward the posterior, maintaining approximately equidistant spacing between five adjacent annuli centers.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex 'double-ring' interlocking structure is visible on the central lateral plane, where two large macro-annuli share a dark-pixel boundary segment.
